name: Planet Purple 1g Pre-Roll
description: Lineage: (Sunset Sherbert × Do Si Dos) & (Zkittlez x Do Si Dos) Breeder: Archive Seed Bank Terpenes: Caryophyllene, Limonene, Linalool Effects: Body Buzz, Euphoric, Calm Aroma: Fruity, Pepper, Citrus Embark on a cosmic journey with Planet Purple, a strain that's truly out of this world! Picture a celestial landscape where lush purple hues meet the sweet aroma of berries and earthy undertones. As you take flight with each inhale, a euphoric wave carries you through the cosmos, leaving stress light-years behind. The experience unfolds like a dazzling meteor shower, sparking creativity and a sense of cosmic connection. Planet Purple is an intergalactic adventure wrapped in a fragrant nebula; buckle up and let the voyage begin!
